tasks.title: Lecture #49
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in an art history class.
tasks.transcript:
Man: When we think of the Renaissance, we often picture grand paintings and sculptures. But a lesser known art form also flourished during this period—tapestry weaving. Tapestries were not only decorative pieces, but also served practical purposes, such as insulating the cold stone walls of castles.
Artists of the era used tapestries to depict intricate scenes from mythology, religion, and daily life, often incorporating vibrant colors and rich textures.
And advantage of tapestries was their portability. Unlike frescoes, which were fixed to walls, tapestries could be rolled up and transported from one location to another, allowing their owners to display their wealth wherever they went.
This portability also had a downside, however. Tapestries were susceptible to damage during transit. Even today, museums faced challenges preserving these unique artworks due to their fragile nature.
The creation of a tapestry was a labor intensive process requiring collaboration between designers, weavers, and dyers. Unlike paintings, which could be completed by a single artist, tapestries were team efforts, and it was common for a designer's sketches to be translated by skilled weavers into woven masterpieces. The intricate craftsmanship required to produce these artworks offers a glimpse into the collaborative spirit of the Renaissance era.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention Renaissance paintings and sculptures?

options.A: To contrast them with a less well-known art form from the same period
options.B: To provide examples of collaborative art forms
options.C: To highlight the religious nature of Renaissance art
options.D: To assert their superiority over other forms of Renaissance art

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：演讲者为什么提到文艺复兴时期的绘画和雕塑？ 定 位 原 文 ： When we think of the Renaissance, we often picture grand paintings and sculptures. But a lesser known art form also flourished during this period — tapestry weaving. 选项分析： A. 为了将它们与同一时期不太知名的艺术形式进行对比。演讲者先说人们通常想到绘画和雕塑，然后用“但是”引出挂毯编织这一较少人知的艺术形式，形成了对比，因此 A 选项正确。 B. 为了提供合作艺术形式的例子。绘画和雕塑通常由单一个体完成，并非合作艺术形式，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 为了强调文艺复兴艺术的宗教性质。演讲者没有讨论绘画和雕塑的宗教内容，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 为了断言它们优于其他文艺复兴艺术形式。演讲者没有比较优劣，只是指出挂毯不太知名，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the talk, what was a key advantage of tapestries over frescoes?

options.B: They could be displayed in museums.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：根据谈话内容，挂毯相对于壁画的一个关键优势是什么？ 定位原文：And advantage of tapestries was their portability. Unlike frescoes, which were fixed to walls, tapestries could be rolled up and transported from one location to another... 选项分析： A. 它们生产成本更低。文本中没有比较成本，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 它们可以在博物馆展出。壁画也可以，这不是优势，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 它们更容易运输。文本明确指出挂毯可以卷起运输，而壁画固定于墙壁，因此 C 选项正确。 D. 它们描绘更复杂的场景。文本没有比较场景复杂度，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what sometimes happened to tapestries while being transported from one location to another?

options.D: Their designs were copied by other artists.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：根据演讲者的说法，挂毯在从一个地方运输到另一个地方时有时会发生什 么？ 定位原文：This portability also had a downside, however. Tapestries were susceptible to damage during transit. 选项分析： A. 它们被用作绝缘材料。这是挂毯的实用功能之一，但与运输无关，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 它们被偷了。文本没有提到盗窃，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 它们被损坏了。文本明确指出挂毯在运输中容易损坏，因此 C 选项正确。 D. 它们的设计被其他艺术家复制。文本没有提到设计复制，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the process of tapestry creation during the Renaissance?

options.A: It required fewer resources than other art forms.
options.B: It involved a collaborative effort among several artisans.
options.C: It was mainly practiced in religious settings.
options.D: It was more popular than painting.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：关于文艺复兴时期挂毯的制作过程，可以推断出什么？ 定 位 原 文 ： The creation of a tapestry was a labor intensive process requiring collaboration between designers, weavers, and dyers. Unlike paintings, which could be completed by a single artist, tapestries were team efforts... 选项分析： A. 它比其他艺术形式需要的资源更少。文本说挂毯制作是劳动密集型的，需要多人合作，没有比较资源多少，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 它涉及多位工匠的合作。文本明确指出挂毯需要设计师、织工和染色工之间的合作，是团队努力，因此 B 选项正确。 C. 它主要在宗教场所进行。文本没有提及制作地点，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 它比绘画更受欢迎。文本只说挂毯是较少人知的艺术形式，因此 D 选项错误。
